summary: DNS of the lid-driven cavity at Re = 3600 (aspect ratio 1.5, regularized lid) to t = 600. The flow relaxes to its steady state.
description: DNS of the lid-driven cavity (aspect ratio 1.5, regularized lid, Re = 3600, lx1 = 12) from the lid profile to t = 600. Re = 3600 is below the first Hopf bifurcation, so the flow relaxes to the steady state with the rate of the leading eigenvalue, 0.0168: the change of the field between t = 500 and t = 600 is 2.4e-5 in the norm of u. The two norm checks use the steady value (the t = 600 value of the run) for the snapshots at t = 500 and t = 600, so a run that has not relaxed by t = 500 fails.

vx_norm_t500.note: Snapshot at t = 500; the reference value is the steady value (t = 600).
